mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing the dispatch history with depot intake was most worthwhile: it identified where the requests disappeared and made the misleading zero understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Repairing the queue-board display was a straightforward but less engaging interlude, especially with only one combination offered.

surprise.text: The intake filter dropped requests for unlisted addresses, so the depot's zero counted admitted records rather than actual need.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the sequence of single offered combinations made the later choices feel automatic rather than exploratory.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see whether exposing the intake gap leads to a practical change beyond Moth revising its advice.
